kind: Source audit of complete recipe factory and current agent operations, with a pure public-validator heading probe; not a visual/interaction audit of every component state

sourceFindings.finding: Agent headingLevel admits 1..6 while the Studio default semantic catalogue registers h1..h4 only. Pure validator rejects h5/h6 with UI_DOC_UNKNOWN_ELEMENT.

Text recipe description mentions a state-bound value, but agent text editing is literal-only and bind is component-prop-only. Canonical UiTextNode.content is a UiExpression; no direct native text-expression binding operation is exposed.

Agent style edits emit base text declarations only. Canonical tokens, reusable styles, media/container conditions and pseudo-state rules are broader; the manual inspector exposes conditional/pseudo controls subject to target guards.

Recipe safe-sibling semantics are incomplete: menubar file identity collision is proven; other first-valued item/tab/accordion/navigation seeds require family-specific repeated-insertion checks rather than assuming they all fail.
Basic Button recipe references ambient state.busy and declares no own initialState; Studio newScreen supplies busy. This is a host dependency, not a newly demonstrated runtime failure.
Generic native labels/section names and literal style seeds do not establish final hierarchy, label association, keyboard/focus behavior, contrast or responsive usability.

strengths: Shared manual/agent canonical insertion, validation, history and persistence
Typed descriptors and compatible slot placement
Independent native/boolean and typed-list recipe wiring
Public upstream-backed controls and extensible canonical style/element data
limitations: No new provider turn, owner document change, browser state change, build or server restart
No assertion that all 83 recipes are visually broken, every seeded first value is defective, or every date is required to write external state
No WCAG conformance, professional-design certification, performance budget or all-state browser test result claimed
Example content, imagery choice and sales-design judgement excluded
professionalReadiness: Capable primitive/component foundation; reliable autonomous professional end-to-end output is not established by current recipes and authoring surface alone
